title: POCT lipid profile data — POCT lipid profile
description: Point-of-care lipid data: cholesterol, HDL, triglycerides and derived values from up to two sets of readings.

ID.title: Row ID
ID.$comment: Local primary key: unique within this table (D090). The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).

PID.title: Participant ID
PID.$comment: Many-to-one link to participant.PID; that every PID exists there cannot be enforced across tables (D090). The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).

APPOINTMENT_VERSION.title: Appointment Version
APPOINTMENT_VERSION.$comment: The source lists no values or format for this string, so none is asserted.

APPOINTMENT_DATETIME.title: Appointment Date and Time.
APPOINTMENT_DATETIME.description: Time is rounded to the nearest hour.
APPOINTMENT_DATETIME.$comment: The dictionary type is datetime but states no delivered string format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).
